## What's new

**Karousel: the music never stops.** From Kultr for Android, which brought it over from KultrDL.

Tap the shuffle button in the player once for shuffle, a second time for **Karousel** (the ∞ icon), and a third time to turn both off. With Karousel on, Kultr adds more music like what's been playing whenever your queue gets to its last song, and keeps going for as long as you listen.

- **Where the songs come from:** your server's similar songs to the track playing, the best-known songs of similar artists and of the artists you're hearing (these need Last.fm set up on Navidrome), and your own library: songs by any of those artists, then the same genres, then what you play most and have hearted.
- **Offline and on your iPhone:** without a connection it carries on with your downloaded songs; with music on this iPhone it uses your folders.
- **Mixes well:** with InjeKt on, the similar songs that mix best out of the track playing come first.
- **Variety:** no more than two songs by one artist at a time, never the same artist twice in a row, and nothing already queued or played in the last three hours.
- **Its own heading.** Karousel's songs show under *Karousel* in Up next, and stay there after Kultr restarts. Turn it off and they leave the queue; turn it on after the music has stopped and it plays on.
- **Repeat:** turning Karousel on switches repeat off, since a repeating queue never runs out.
- **On the large widget** the shuffle button switches the same way and shows ∞ while Karousel is on.

Karousel takes over from "Keep playing similar music" and keeps its setting, so if that was on (the default), Karousel is on. Its switch is now in **Settings → Playback**.

### Also
- **Shuffle and repeat** sit on a tinted disc while they're on, so you can tell at a glance.
- **Night mode** can be switched on while the theme is Light: it switches to Dark, as asking for black means you want it dark.
- **The icon** is now drawn from the same outline as Kultr for Android's, so it's sharp at every size.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` in SideStore and update from there.

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
